newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Francisco, Calif. TRANs.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL
CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO
1996-1997 TAX AND REVENUE ANTICIPATION NOTES
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Board of Supervisors of
the City and County of San Francisco (the "City"), State of
California, intends to offer for public sale on
October 2, 1996
at 8:00 a.m., California Time, at the Law Offices of Lesli
M. Lava, 580 California Street, Suite 1600, San Francisco,
California 94104, not to exceed $60,000,000 principal amount
of tax and revenue anticipation notes of the City and County
of San Francisco designated "City and County of San
Francisco 1996-1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes" (the
"Notes"). The Controller of the City reserves the right to
postpone or cancel the sale upon notice given through the
Munifacts News Service not less than twenty-four (24) hours
prior to the time bids are to be received. If the sale is
postponed, bids will be received on such date and at such
hour and place, as the Controller of the City shall
determine, and notice of the new date for receipt of bids
shall be given by the Clerk of the Board through the
Munifacts News Service not less than twenty-four (24) hours
prior to the time bids are to be received. As an
accommodation to bidders, telephone or fax notice of the
postponement of the sale date and of the new sale date will
be given to any bidder requesting such notice from City and
County of San Francisco, 401 Van Ness Avenue, Room 402, San
Francisco, California 94102, Attention: Stephanie Carlisle,
bidders to receive such Munifacts News Service, telephone or
fax notice shall not affect the legality of the sale.
NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN THAT THE NOTES WILL BE
OFFERED FOR PUBLIC SALE SUBJECT TO THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS
OF THE OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE FOR THE NOTES. BIDDERS ARE
SPECIFICALLY REFERRED TO THE ENTIRE OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE
FOR COMPLETE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE SALE.
Copies of the Official Notice of Sale and the Preliminary
Official Statement relating to the Notes will be furnished
upon request received by October 1, 1996, at City and County
of San Francisco, 401 Van Ness Avenue, Room 402, San
Francisco, California 94102, Attention: Stephanie Carlisle,
Dated: September 17, 1996
/s/ John L. Taylor
Clerk of the Board of Supervisors
City and County of San Francisco,
State of California
(From The Bond Buyer)
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
